source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_users" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i users (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the users OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_users SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve only Project-approved, non-secret BMC user-account metadata over SNMPv3 and compare account identity surrogate, enabled state and role/privilege semantics with an authorized baseline without disclosing credentials or security material.
original_method: An engineer enables an SNMPv3 account in WebUI and uses IReasoning MIB Browser Get Next/Get Subtree on an undefined `$target`; Criteria separately require Net-SNMP retrieval with no user-field or privacy boundary.
manual_activity: An engineer/security owner must approve the exact non-secret fields, test-account baseline, pseudonymization/redaction policy and least-privilege SNMPv3 setup. The agent can then query only allowlisted objects and compare redacted metadata.
required_inputs: vendor MIB module/version and exact user-metadata OIDs
allowlisted fields and explicitly forbidden password/hash/key/token/auth/privacy objects
authorized test-account identity surrogate, enabled/disabled state and role/privilege baseline
least-privilege SNMPv3 security profile through protected secret injection
isolated manager ACL and configuration restore path
safety_requirements: Do not enable SNMPv3 or create/change any BMC account, role or ACL until the owner approves the setup and restore path.
Never query or persist passwords, hashes, keys, tokens, authentication/privacy secrets or an unrestricted user subtree.
Do not use v2c or the generic `.1.3.6.1.4.1.8072...` example; restrict SNMPv3 access to exact allowlisted read-only objects.
Apply redaction or pseudonymization before persistence and scan artifacts for forbidden values; stop immediately on an unexpected field or broader access.
Do not infer account correctness from row count alone; compare identity, state and role semantics against the authorized baseline.
Contain and escalate any suspected disclosure, restore temporary access and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, resolve only allowlisted vendor-MIB objects and perform bounded exact SNMPv3 reads with output filtering before storage.
Compare pseudonymized account identity, state and role/privilege values with the authorized baseline and report missing, extra or mismatched entries.
Do not operate WebUI, create/modify/delete users, handle plaintext secrets, claim IReasoning coverage when only Net-SNMP ran or set the final verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact object/field allowlist, forbidden-secret list, account/role/state baseline and pseudonymization/retention rules.
Configure and restore the least-privilege SNMPv3 test account/ACL and approve client equivalence.
Investigate any unexpected exposure or account mismatch, rotate credentials if exposure is suspected and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The v2c generic subtree and full-output instruction may enumerate sensitive material, lacks a verified vendor user-table mapping and cannot prove account state or role correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact allowlisted vendor-MIB SNMPv3 objects, least-privilege access and filtering before persistence; retain typed field/index evidence while pseudonymizing identities according to policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, SNMPv3 WebUI/account setup, undefined `$target`, Net-SNMP Criteria and 10/5-minute values remain preserved source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT USER-METADATA AND DATA-MINIMIZATION CONTRACT REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map only approved identity-surrogate, enabled-state and role/privilege fields to exact OIDs, enforce access at the manager/BMC boundary, collect a bounded SNMPv3 response through a pre-storage filter and compare it with an authorized pseudonymized baseline.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The identified BMC firmware/account model and matching vendor MIB.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, MIB module, account schema and client versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor user-management MIB/security guide plus Project identity and evidence-handling policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds field allowlisting, negative secret-disclosure checks, pseudonymization and semantic baseline comparison without replacing the original client checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Net-SNMP may prove the same object values when approved but not IReasoning UI behavior; redaction must preserve role/state comparability while minimizing identity exposure.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact OIDs/fields, baseline, least-privilege profile, forbidden-data list, filter and client decision.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Account enumeration is sensitive even without credentials; an overly broad walk or post-hoc-only redaction can create a disclosure incident.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may pseudonymize account identities and approve Net-SNMP instead of IReasoning only after documenting original/actual tool, object-level equivalence, omitted fields and unverified GUI coverage. It may narrow evidence but cannot omit required state/role semantics or permit secret collection.
expected_evidence: approved object/field allowlist, forbidden-secret list and authorized pseudonymized account baseline
redacted SNMPv3 WebUI/test-account/ACL configuration and cleanup artifacts
vendor MIB identity with numeric OID/type/index/field mapping
bounded typed SNMPv3 output filtered before persistence and artifact secret-scan result
pseudonymized account presence/state/role comparison including missing and extra entries
tool-equivalence statement, authorization errors, BMC health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires IReasoning/SNMPv3 while Criteria changes to Net-SNMP, `$target` and permitted user fields are absent, and DeepSeek changes to v2c plus an unrelated generic subtree. The intended read-only user-metadata check remains identifiable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The user-metadata purpose and target domain are clear. Exact objects, allowed fields, baseline, redaction and approved security setup are Project execution-readiness inputs; once approved, bounded filtered collection is feasible. They require a hard execution gate but not a permanent BLOCKED review classification.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains hybrid execution but rejects v2c, the generic subtree and unfiltered full output; replaces them with least-privilege allowlisted SNMPv3 evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 because owner-supplied data-governance and object inputs can make the clear purpose safely executable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the classification while correcting its contradictory prior-comparison wording and adding pre-storage filtering and exposure response.

review_improvement: Makes data minimization and negative secret-disclosure evidence part of acceptance, while retaining enough typed state/role information to judge the actual user-monitoring purpose.
independent_technical_reasoning: A broad user-table walk can expose sensitive identities or security material even when read-only. That risk requires an allowlist, least privilege and filtering before persistence, not substitution with a generic command. Because the approved metadata and baseline can be supplied by the Project and the purpose is clear, the case is readiness-gated REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than permanently BLOCKED.
